text: The Finish in Four plan for the Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration is for students matriculating in the academic year 2025-2026. Curriculum Requirements can be fulfilled by other approved courses from accredited institutions of higher education. The courses listed are recommended as the most efficient way to satisfy both Core Curriculum and Major Requirements at UT Dallas. This plan may be adjusted based on individual need. For official degree requirements visit https://catalog.utdallas.edu/now/undergraduate/programs/jsom/business-administration. Minimum Overall GPA: 2.0. Total Semester Credit Hours (SCH): 120.

text: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration Finish in Four plan, Year 1. Fall (16 SCH): MATH 1325 (020): Applied Calculus I [Prerequisite: ALEKS Score Required or MATH 1314 w/ grade C- or better] (see note 1); BLAW 2301: Business and Public Law; BA 1105: Professional Development (first time freshman) or BA 3105: Professional Development (transfer students); 3 SCH American/State History (060); 3 SCH Communications (010); and 3 SCH Language, Philosophy and Culture (040). Spring (15 SCH): 3 SCH from the following: BA 1310, BA 1320, ECON 2301, or ECON 2302 OR Social and Behavioral Sciences Core (080); 3 SCH Creative Arts (050); 3 SCH American/State History (060); 3 SCH Communications (010); and 3 SCH Life and Physical Sciences (030).
source_title: Finish in Four: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration

text: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration Finish in Four plan, Year 2. Fall (15 SCH): REAL/FIN 3305: Real Estate Principles (see note 2); ACCT 2301: Introductory Financial Accounting; 6 SCH from the following: BA 1310, BA 1320, ECON 2301, or ECON 2302 OR Component Area Option Core (090); and OPRE 3360: Managerial Methods in Decision Making Under Uncertainty or STAT 3360: Probability and Statistics for Management and Economics [Prerequisite for STAT 3360: MATH 1326]. Spring (15 SCH): REAL/FIN 4321: Real Estate Law and Contracts [Prerequisite or Corequisite: REAL/FIN 3305] (see note 2); ACCT 2302: Introductory Management Accounting [Prerequisite: ACCT 2301]; ITSS 3300: Information Technology for Business; FIN 3320: Business Finance [Prerequisite: ACCT 2301 AND OPRE 3360 or STAT 3360]; and 3 SCH Government/Political Science (070).
source_title: Finish in Four: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration

text: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration Finish in Four plan, Year 3. Fall (15 SCH): BUAN 3301: Artificial Intelligence in Business; OPRE 3330: Project Management; OBHR 3310: Organizational Behavior or OBHR 3330: Introduction to Human Resource Management; MKT 3300: Principles of Marketing; and 3 SCH Major Related Courses - any FIN upper-division course (see note 2). Spring (15 SCH): REAL/FIN 3358: Real Estate Markets and Investments [Prerequisites: REAL/FIN 3305] (see note 2); BCOM 3300: Business Communication [Prerequisite: BA 1105 or BA 3105]; BA 3300: Advanced Topics in Capitalism: Ideas and Challenges That Shape Our World; OPRE 3310: Supply Chain and Operations Management [Prerequisite: MATH 1325, MATH 2413, or MATH 2417]; BA 4090: Management Internship (see note 3) [Department permission required]; and 3 SCH Government/Political Science (070).
source_title: Finish in Four: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration

text: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration Finish in Four plan, Year 4. Fall (15 SCH): REAL/FIN 4328: Real Estate Valuation Capstone [Prerequisite: REAL/FIN 3305 and REAL/FIN 3358. Co-requisite REAL/FIN 3365.] (see note 2); REAL/FIN 3365: Real Estate Finance & Principles [Prerequisite: REAL/FIN 3305. Prerequisite or Corequisite: REAL/FIN 3358] (see note 2); IMS 3310: International Business [Prerequisite: BA 1310, BA 1320, or ECON 2301]; BA 4095: Social Sector Engagement and Community Outreach Practicum (see note 4); 3 SCH Free Elective or 1 of the following classes: BPS 4396, ENTP 4340, MKT 4360; and 3 SCH Free Elective. Spring (14 SCH): BPS 4395: Capstone Senior Project or 3 SCH Major Related Courses (see note 5); BPS 4305: Strategic Management (see note 6); 3 SCH Life and Physical Sciences (030); and 5 SCH Free Elective.
source_title: Finish in Four: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration

text: Note 1 (MATH 1325): MATH 1325 is required for all JSOM undergraduate students. Students may substitute MATH 2413 or MATH 2417 for MATH 1325. To make timely degree progress, students should complete MATH 1325 or its equivalent by the end of their first semester at UT Dallas. Students who will not meet this requirement should contact their academic advisor to discuss their degree timeline. Note 2 (Real Estate Finance Major Related Courses): Students must take REAL 3305, REAL 3358, REAL 3365, REAL 4321, REAL 4328. The final 3 semester credit hours are any FIN upper-division course not used elsewhere on the degree plan. Completing REAL 4328, required for this concentration, satisfies a capstone requirement.
source_title: Finish in Four: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration
section_heading: Notes: MATH 1325 and Real Estate Finance Major Related Courses

text: Note 3 (Internship): An Internship (Practicum) of at least 160 working hours is required for all JSOM majors. Enroll in BA 4090 at the time of internship for 0 credit hours to fulfill degree requirement only. Students who are employed in full-time jobs may fulfill their internship requirement with their current employer as a special project for registration in BA 4090 with preapproval from their program director. BA 4090 does NOT need to be completed in spring of year three but must be completed in order to graduate. Students can move the internship to any semester, including summer.
source_title: Finish in Four: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration

text: Note 4 (Community Engagement): A Community Engagement Experience is required for all JSOM majors in fall 2018 catalog or later. Students may fulfill the requirement with BPS 4396 or ENTP 4340 or MKT 4360 for 3 semester credit hours JSOM Major Core, or with BA 4095 upon completion of 100 service hours for 0-hour degree requirement only. If completing BA 4095, the student must complete 3 hours of free elective credit to satisfy the total of 120 semester credit hours - 45 semester credit hours of which must be upper division - required for graduation.
source_title: Finish in Four: Business Administration (BS) - Real Estate Finance Concentration

text: Note 5 (BPS 4395 Capstone Senior Project): BPS 4395 Prerequisites: Junior or Senior standing and ACCT 2301, FIN 3320, ITSS 3300, HMGT 3301, MKT 3300, OPRE 3310, IMS 3310, OBHR 3310, or OBHR 3330. Prerequisite or Corequisite: BCOM 3300. Note 6 (BPS 4305 Strategic Management): BPS 4305 Prerequisites: BA 1105 or BA 3105 and ACCT 2301, FIN 3320, HMGT 3301, IMS 3310, ITSS 3300, MKT 3300, OBHR 3310, OBHR 3330, or OPRE 3310.
